svg.title: Sysvia 2.3.3 — A smoother view of your Windows PC
svg.desc: Release 2.3.3 introduces a new Windows screen engine. Up to 140 fps at 2560 × 1440 measured on an NVIDIA PC. Off by default, with an automatic fallback.
svg.text: Meet the new Sysvia screen engine.
Off by default. Automatic fallback built in.
